concept.title: Scalable documentation architecture
concept.shortdesc: DITA supports large-scale documentation ecosystems by allowing writers to structure content through maps, enable modular

conbody.p: DITA supports large-scale documentation ecosystems by allowing writers to structure content through maps, enable modular growth, and support enterprise-level governance and reuse.

Maps function as organizational containers that assemble topics into meaningful sequences without embedding the content itself. This separation between content (topics) and organization (maps) enables unprecedented scalability.
